data.narrative:
Dronamics is a Series A-stage autonomous delivery drone company founded by Svilen and Konstantin Rangelov. The Drones & Autonomous sector contains eight private peers (including Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air) and no public comparables. A narrowly-filtered peer-median approach is not applicable here: while five same-sector companies exist, insufficient datapoints meet simultaneous filters for stage, valuation tier, and business model alignment, creating unacceptable selection bias.

Valuation analysis therefore relies on stage-progression methodology. Using the $43.2M in total capital raised as a value proxy, a typical Series A-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.0x implies a post-money valuation of $86.4M. This method anchors to observed progression patterns in frontier-tech venture financing rather than to a sparse or misaligned peer set.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $73M to $99M, with $86M as the median estimate. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, regulatory pathways for autonomous delivery operations, and the durability of unit economics in drone logistics—none of which can be resolved through valuation multiples alone. The single-method reliance reflects genuine data scarcity rather than analytical preference and warrants heightened scrutiny of operational and commercial diligence prior to investment.
